channel.title: Surveying – HxGN Spotlight
channel.description: Hexagon’s platform for original stories from opinion leaders and customers

item.title: Women in tech: Surveying South Africa with Tumeka Bikitsha
item.dc:creator: Heather Tuggle
item.description: Discover Tumeka Bikitsha's experience as a land surveyor in South Africa, her embrace of technology and her impact on progressing industry norms.

item.title: Tales of the Surveyor: Secrets to becoming a successful surveyor
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of the 'Tales of the surveyor' podcast, Boštjan Hrovat, owner of a small surveying company Geo-Etika, discusses his life as a surveyor and a surveying company owner.

item.title: The future of construction innovation
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN Radio, we sat down with Paul Holley, professor and director of the Center for Construction Innovation and Collaboration at Auburn University, to discuss how to empower the next generation of surveying and construction professionals to build the future.

item.title: What tomorrow’s surveyors want you to know
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN Radio, we sat down with students from Oregon State University’s Civil Engineering Geomatics program to explore the changes that are occurring in the surveying profession as the next generation start to enter the workforce.

item.title: Grow your business with Mobile Mapping
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN TV, we discuss the latest advancement in Mobile Mapping and how intuitive and autonomous workflows make Mobile Mapping accessible to more professionals than ever before, opening more business and revenue opportunities for surveyors.

item.title: Grow your business with monitoring
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Monitoring is a growth market and thus a promising field for surveyors who want to branch out. Surveyors can easily get into simple manual monitoring using their existing surveying knowledge and, as they gain experience, venture into more advanced automated monitoring projects.

item.title: Leveraging technology to attract talent
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, we sat down with Ray Murphy, Chief Strategy Officer and Founder of Murphy Geospatial, to discuss how he attracts and retains the best talent through new technologies.

item.title: Reality capture for an autonomous future
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN TV, Juergen Mayer, President, Reality Capture, from Leica Geosystems, part of Hexagon, discusses the role of reality capture technology in creating a digital twin and the fusion of smart digital realities.

item.title: HxGN LIVE Global – Building Blocks for the Surveying Future
item.dc:creator: Timothy Burch
item.description: The future of surveying will require the use of emerging technology to attract new geospatialists; attending Hexagon LIVE Global 2022 has covered the bases.

item.title: Get kids into survey
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN Radio, we discuss why and how attracting new talent to the surveying profession matters in creating a sustainable, autonomous future.
